about: Provenance of every published image. All are AI-generated by the project or built from those images; none carries legible text except the example plate's quotation. sha256 is of the published file.
processing: paintings: long edge 1600 px (Lanczos), JPEG quality 80; drift pair: 1000 px, quality 82; the comparison sheet is the original file with metadata segments removed; the plate was re-encoded from PNG at quality 85. All metadata removed (EXIF, XMP, IPTC, ICC, C2PA/JUMBF provenance manifests, comments) with tools/art/export_web_copies.py.
finish_b: image-to-image repaint with gemini-3-pro-image-preview; prompt in painting-briefs.json (finish_prompt)
